payload.title: Email attachment intake: save project document to project folder and confirm by reply
payload.description: A colleague emails Morgan a project PDF (brief, timeline, budget, etc.) and asks Morgan to save it with the other project files and confirm. Morgan opens the attachment in Preview to check its content, uses Mail's Save dialog to save it directly into the matching /Users/morgan/Documents/Projects/<ProjectName> folder (verified afterward in Finder), then replies to the sender confirming it has been filed.
payload.trigger: An email arrives from a colleague (e.g. Alex Moreau, Priya Shah) with a project-related PDF attached and a request to save/file it and confirm.
payload.outcome: The attachment is saved into the correct Projects/<ProjectName> folder (confirmed present in Finder alongside prior project files) and Morgan sends a short reply to the sender confirming receipt and filing.
handoffs: Colleague sends the document and request via email -> Morgan files it and replies, closing the loop with the sender.
variations: Sender explicitly asks to 'save it with the other project files and let me know' (Atlas brief, Alex Moreau) vs 'file it in the project folder and confirm' (Beacon budget, Priya Shah) vs an informal follow-up 'same place as the brief please' for a second document in the same project (Atlas timeline, Alex Moreau) - wording varies but the save+confirm pattern is consistent.

Confirmation reply wording varies each time ('Hi Alex, got it, saved with the Atlas files. Thanks, Morgan' / 'Thanks Priya, filed in the Beacon folder. Morgan' / 'Saved next to the brief. Thanks Alex') but always names the folder/location and thanks the sender.
When it's a second document for an already-known project (Atlas timeline following the Atlas brief), Morgan does not need to create a new folder - the existing Projects/Atlas folder is reused.
Versioned documents (Beacon-budget-v1.pdf then v2.pdf) are saved alongside the prior version rather than overwriting it.
openQuestions: Is there a consistent project-folder-naming convention beyond matching the project name mentioned in the email subject?
Does Morgan ever delay the save/reply to a later session, or is it always done immediately within the same sitting as observed in all three instances?
Is there any check for duplicate or near-duplicate filenames before saving (e.g. would a second 'v2' accidentally overwrite)?
limitations: Only one week of activity history was available; all three observed instances occurred within the same 7-day window (2026-10-13, 2026-10-15, 2026-10-16), so weekly/longer-term recurrence frequency could not be independently confirmed beyond this cluster.
Both senders are from the same external domain (northbeam.co) in all observed instances - unclear if this pattern also applies to internal or other external senders.

Precise end-to-end duration per instance (approx. 1.5-2.5 minutes observed) is not included as a formal timing run because exact boundary matching against recorder text proved unreliable; captureSequence below gives the raw sequence of app-switch timestamps instead.
